page: Amazon Web Services t8i.medium is an x86_64 architecture server belonging to the t8i burstable performance family. It is equipped with an Intel processor operating at a clock speed of 3.9 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 2 virtual CPUs derived from 1 physical core with 2 threads per core, backed by a dedicated CPU allocation. The system is provisioned with 4.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per core.

This instance runs on the AWS Nitro hypervisor. It does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached volumes. The baseline network bandwidth is rated at 0 Gbps, and the instance does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses. There are no onboard GPUs.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the t8i.medium is designed as a budget-friendly option for workloads that do not require continuous high CPU utilization or local storage. Due to its burstable performance profile, 4.0 GB memory capacity, and lack of local storage, this server is suited for lightweight applications, development and testing environments, small web servers, or basic microservices that experience intermittent traffic.
